profile_text.body:
Perplexity describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question. The company is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Its tracked products are Perplexity AI, described as a search-augmented LLM, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise search product whose listed features include internal knowledge search, data indexing, SSO, and audit logs. Two MCP servers are also listed: ai.perplexity/mcp-server, described as real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and ai.smithery/arjunkmrm-perplexity-search, which enables AI assistants to perform web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro.

Perplexity is a defendant in nine tracked cases. These include Gagleard v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the District Court for the Northern District of California and a second Gagleard case in the Eastern District of California; Noel v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the Northern District of California; Amazon.com Services LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the Northern District of California and Amazon.com Services, LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit; and four cases in the Southern District of New York brought by Cable News Network Inc, The New York Times Company, Chicago Tribune Company, LLC, and Encyclopaedia Britannica, Inc. The litigation is concentrated in California.
